defs.def: a flat piece of metal, usually shaped like a coin, that is given to the winner of a competition or to sb who has been brave, for example in war 奖章；勋章verb

ex.s: A swimmer training to win an Olympic medal.
ex.t: 一名为赢得奥运奖牌而训练的游泳运动员。

ex.s: His effort to reunite families with lost medals began with a Christmas gift from his mother, a Purple Heart with the name Corrado A.
ex.t: 他让家庭与丢失勋章重聚的努力，始于母亲送的一份圣诞礼物——一枚刻着科拉多·A之名的紫心勋章。

ex.s: So when his mother gave him the medal, he knew right away what he had to do.
ex.t: 所以当他母亲把这枚勋章交给他时，他立刻知道自己该做什么。

ex.s: Before hearing from Zac, Adeline hadn’t realized the medal was missing.
ex.t: 在收到扎克的来信之前，阿德琳并没有意识到勋章丢失了。

ex.s: Like many military medals, the one Zac’s mother had found was a family treasure." This medal was very precious to my parents.
ex.t: 像许多军事奖章一样，扎克的母亲找到的那枚是家族珍宝。“这枚奖章对我父母非常珍贵。”

ex.s: As a child, Adeline couldn't understand why the medal was so significant.
ex.t: 小时候，阿德琳无法理解这枚勋章为何如此重要。

ex.s: “But as I grew older,” Adeline says, "and missed my brother more and more, I realized that was the only thing we had left." Corrado Piccoli’s Purple Heart medal now hangs at the Italian American Civic Association in Watertown.
ex.t: "但随着年龄的增长，"阿德琳说，"而且我越来越想念我的哥哥，我才意识到这是我们唯一留下的东西。"科拉多·皮科利的紫心勋章现在挂在沃特敦意大利美国公民协会。

ex.s: Zac recently returned another lost medal to a family in Alabama.
ex.t: 扎克最近把另一枚丢失的勋章归还给阿拉巴马州的一个家庭。

ex.s: Since he first reunited Corrado’s medal, Zac says his record is now 5 for 5.
ex.t: 自从他第一次让科拉多的勋章团聚以来，扎克说他的记录现在是5次成功5次。

ex.s: Where did Zac get a Purple Heart medal for himself？
ex.t: 扎克自己的紫心勋章是从哪里得到的？

ex.s: In fact, I got the same medal as the one that the guy who came in first place had.
ex.t: 事实上，我得到的奖牌和得第一名的那个人得到的一模一样。

ex.s: But for Alistair，his decision was easy to explain: "Mum wouldn't have been happy if I'd left Jonny behind." At that moment, he was no longer an athlete aiming for a medal-he was just a brother.
ex.t: 但对于阿利斯泰尔来说，他的决定很容易解释： “如果我把乔尼留在身后，妈妈就不会高兴了。“那一刻，他不再是一个瞄准奖牌的运动员，他只是一个兄弟。

ex.s: If China wins this point, they will walk out of the stadium with an Olympic gold medal.
ex.t: 如果中国赢了这一分，他们将带着奥运金牌走出体育场。

ex.t: 这也为卡森赢得了后继的总统自由勋章,并将她的脸贴在美国17美分邮票上.
